subject: Renewal kickoff: VectorHealth capacity, term options, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Wu <emma.wu@vectorhealth.com>, VectorHealth Procurement <procurement@vectorhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity + term options / scheduling QBR

Emma / VectorHealth team —

Thanks for the productive run of the pilot. Per our renewal conversation, we want to kick off a short renewal + expansion orchestration to cover:
• capacity sizing for anticipated peak August–December usage (spike runway)
• term options (12 vs 24 mos + staircase commit) and unit pricing implications
• procurement / legal path and timeline to signature
• QBR scheduling to align execs and ops for the handoff

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm primary stakeholders from your side (finance/procurement, legal, SPOC for ops).
2) Pick one of these times for a 45m QBR next week: Sept 8 10:00–10:45 PT, Sept 9 14:00–14:45 PT, Sept 10 09:00–09:45 PT.
3) Share simple traffic/peak RPS and attachment (sample requests/day) so we can size the Dedicated/reserved pool.

I've attached a one-page mutual_action_plan.docx (draft) that maps milestones to owners; we'll update with dates once we lock the QBR slot. Ben, Neha, Laura — looping you for pricing/ops/legal talking points.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx (draft)

Attendees from our side: Tom Clarke (CFO), myself (Head of Platform), and I'll bring in procurement (procurement@vectorhealth.com) for the commercial path. Legal will join for signature reviews once we have terms.

Sept 9 at 14:00 PT works best for Tom. I've attached our procurement_spreadsheet.xlsx — it contains our standard PO language and preferred billing cadence (net 45).

On sizing: we'll share a quick snapshot of average and peak token throughput by EOD tomorrow.

—Emma

• Attached VectorHealth_SOW_v3.pdf — this includes the 12/24 month price matrix and staircase commit language. Please confirm whether VectorHealth prefers a firm 24-month or a 12-month with an optional extension at pre-agreed tiers.
• Billing cadence: we can support net 30 / net 45 / quarterly invoicing — if procurement prefers net 45 as indicated, we need that confirmed for the contract.

If you want, we can sketch an example commit ladder (3-step staircase) in the QBR so finance can visualize monthly unit cost vs committed throughput.

Thanks Rafael / Emma — I'm adding a short proposed QBR agenda and a scheduling poll to lock the slot.
Proposed agenda (45m):
1) Exec alignment (Tom + Rafael) — 10m
2) Production health & peak sizing (VectorHealth ops) — 10m
3) Pricing/term options & financial impact (Ben/Finance) — 10m
4) Procurement/legal next steps & signature path (Laura) — 10m
5) Action items & timeline (mutual action plan update) — 5m

I'll send a Doodle poll (link below) with the three candidate times Rafael suggested. Also a quick ask for engineering: could you share a sample 72-hour traffic extract (UTC timestamps) and peak RPS for the last 30 days so our infra team can validate Dedicated sizing?

Neha — attaching the traffic snapshot you requested inline below (summary):
• 30-day average token throughput: ~1.4M tokens/day
• 30-day peak 10m RPS: 420 requests/minute (7 RPS sustained bursts)
• High-peak windows are typically 14:00–16:00 PT weekdays (billing spike)

Sept 9 at 14:00 PT confirmed for our team. Tom will join for the first 20 minutes. Procurement will follow up on PO language and net45 (we can accept net45 if signed before Sept 30).

Emma

• VectorHealth: confirm PO path + preferred billing cadence (procurement) — due Sept 7
• VectorHealth: share 72-hour sample traffic extract (ops) — due Sept 7
• Redwood (Ben): prepare 12/24 pricing comparison and staircase commit example — due Sept 8

See you on Sept 9.
